home.introBody: [HR] Before I became a homeopath I was a research scientist. I hold a PhD in Natural Sciences and I co-authored a biology textbook that has been on the compulsory reading list for undergraduate science courses in Croatia for over a decade. I came to homeopathy after a difficult post-partum period, when it helped me personally. I have been in private practice in London since 2009.
home.introBody2: [HR] That training has stayed with me. I listen closely, I take careful notes, I look for patterns, and I am honest with you about what I can and cannot say.

home.whatTitle: [HR] What homeopathy is, in plain terms
home.whatBody: [HR] Homeopathy is a type of medicine that treats the body as one unique integrated system, rather than isolating single organs that are studied separately and treated by different medical specialties. home.whatBody2: [HR] In practice it means a long conversation, careful observation, and a remedy chosen for you as an individual. The body is gently stimulated to heal itself. Small changes make a big difference.

about.seoTitle: [HR] About Nataša Perić | Homeopath in London since 2009
about.seoDescription: [HR] Nataša Perić, PhD in Natural Sciences, homeopath in private practice in London since 2009 and supervisor at the Centre for Homeopathic Education.
about.title: [HR] About Natasa
about.standfirst: [HR] I am a homeopath in private practice in London. Before that I was a research scientist. Both of those things shape how I work.

sections.heading: [HR] How I came to this work
sections.body: [HR] I trained and worked as a research scientist and I did not expect to end up here. I came to homeopathy after a difficult post-partum period, when it helped me personally, at a point when I was not looking for it. I wanted to understand why. That question turned into a training, and then into a practice, and I have been seeing clients in London since 2009.

sections.heading: [HR] Where the science shows up
sections.body: [HR] My PhD is in Natural Sciences and I co-authored a biology textbook that has been on the compulsory reading list for undergraduate science courses in Croatia for over a decade. What I carry from that is method. I listen closely, I record carefully, I look for the pattern that connects things rather than the loudest single symptom, and I am careful with language. If something is uncertain, I will say so.

sections.heading: [HR] How I work with you
sections.body: [HR] I work with you and for you. This is a partnership between us, built on mutual trust and respect, on honesty and openness. Your treatment is tailored to you as an individual, and it moves at the pace your health actually moves at. I am not the authority in the room. You know things about your own body that I need you to tell me.

sections.heading: [HR] Who I work best with
sections.body: [HR] The people I work best with are people who work on themselves. Many have done some form of therapy. They are committed to their wellbeing and they are tuned in to what is going on in their bodies. This is a considered, gradual way of working, and it asks something of you. If you are looking for something immediate, I am probably not the right person, and I would rather say that early.

sections.heading: [HR] Teaching and supervision
sections.body: [HR] I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, where I lead the Research Proposition module. Supervision keeps me in contact with how the next generation of practitioners is being trained, and it keeps my own thinking honest.

credentials: [HR] LCHE, Licentiate of the Centre for Homeopathic Education
[HR] In private practice in London since 2009
[HR] Lecturer and supervisor, Centre for Homeopathic Education, London
[HR] Registered with the Complementary Therapist Association
about.closingBody: [HR] The first consultation is long and unhurried. It is the best way to find out whether this way of working suits you.

homeopathy.seoTitle: [HR] What homeopathy is | Homeopathy with Natasa, London
homeopathy.seoDescription: [HR] Homeopathy treats the body as one integrated system rather than isolated organs. What a consultation is like, what it may support, and how remedies are sent.
homeopathy.title: [HR] Homeopathy
homeopathy.standfirst: [HR] A type of medicine that treats the body as one unique integrated system, in order to identify the root cause of symptoms.
homeopathy.whatBody: [HR] Conventional medicine has become very good at studying organs separately. The heart, the gut, the skin, the hormones: each one is studied on its own and treated by a different specialty. That division is useful, and it is also why a person with several connected symptoms can end up with several separate explanations and no single one.
homeopathy.whatBody2: [HR] Homeopathy starts from the other end. It treats the body as one unique integrated system, and it reads symptoms as expressions of that whole system rather than as separate faults. The aim is to identify the root cause rather than to quieten each symptom in turn. The remedy is chosen for you as an individual, and the body is gently stimulated to heal itself.
notItems: [HR] It is not a replacement for your doctor. Please keep your medical care, and please tell me about it.
[HR] It is not mystical. I am a former research scientist and I speak plainly about what is known and what is not.
[HR] It is not fast. Longstanding patterns rarely shift quickly, and I will not pretend otherwise.
[HR] It is not passive. You are an active part of this, and what you notice between sessions matters.
homeopathy.supportTitle: [HR] What people come to me with
homeopathy.supportIntro: [HR] People come to me at many different points. Most often they are living with something that has continued for a long time and has been looked at in pieces. Homeopathy may support the person as a whole while that is going on. I do not make claims about outcomes for named conditions.
supportItems: [HR] Hormonal changes across different stages of life
[HR] Low energy and exhaustion that has no clear explanation
[HR] Recurrent complaints that keep returning in the same pattern
[HR] Sleep, tension and states of mind that sit alongside physical symptoms
[HR] Wanting support during a demanding period rather than treatment for one thing

consultationSteps.heading: [HR] Before we meet
consultationSteps.body: [HR] You book a time and I send you a short form. Nothing complicated. It helps me arrive prepared.

consultationSteps.heading: [HR] The first consultation
consultationSteps.body: [HR] We talk for around ninety minutes. I will ask about your health history, but also about sleep, appetite, temperature, energy, mood, what makes things better and what makes them worse. Some questions will feel unrelated. They are how the pattern becomes visible.

consultationSteps.heading: [HR] After we talk
consultationSteps.body: [HR] I take time to study your case properly before choosing anything. This is the part of the work you do not see, and it is where the research training earns its place.

consultationSteps.heading: [HR] Your remedy
consultationSteps.body: [HR] I select a remedy for you as an individual and explain how and when to take it, in writing, so you are not relying on memory.

consultationSteps.heading: [HR] Follow-up
consultationSteps.body: [HR] We usually meet again after four to six weeks. We look at what has changed, including small things, and adjust. Small changes make a big difference.

homeopathy.remediesBody: [HR] Remedies are prepared by an established homeopathic pharmacy and posted to your address in the UK, usually arriving within a few days. If you are outside the UK we will agree the arrangement together before your consultation. Remedy costs are separate from the consultation fee and are modest.
homeopathy.remediesBody2: [HR] You will always receive written instructions. If anything is unclear afterwards, write to me. I would rather answer a short question than have you guessing.
homeopathy.askBody: [HR] Honesty and openness, including about the things that feel small or awkward. Patience, because this is gradual. And that you stay in touch between sessions if something changes. In return you have my full attention, my time, and a straight answer whenever I have one.

mentoring.seoDescription: [HR] One-to-one and small group supervision for homeopathy students and newly qualified practitioners, with a lecturer at the Centre for Homeopathic Education.
mentoring.title: [HR] Mentoring and supervision
mentoring.standfirst: [HR] For homeopathy students and newly qualified practitioners who would like a steady, practical second opinion.
forItems: [HR] Students in clinical training who want to talk a case through properly
[HR] Newly qualified practitioners setting up their first practice
[HR] Anyone working on a research proposition or written case work
mentoring.oneToOneBody: [HR] A session for your cases and your questions. We look at what you gathered, what you may have missed, and how you reached your decision. The aim is not to hand you an answer. It is to make your own reasoning clearer and more repeatable.
mentoring.groupBody: [HR] Small groups, so that everyone speaks. One or two cases per session, presented by members of the group, discussed openly. Practitioners often learn as much from a case that is not theirs.

howSteps.heading: [HR] You send the case in advance
howSteps.body: [HR] So that I arrive having read it, and our time goes on the thinking rather than the summary.

howSteps.heading: [HR] We work through it together
howSteps.body: [HR] Case taking, analysis, remedy reasoning, and what you would do differently next time.

howSteps.heading: [HR] You leave with notes
howSteps.body: [HR] A short written summary of what we agreed, for your records and your training log.

mentoring.backgroundBody: [HR] I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, where I lead the Research Proposition module. I have been in practice since 2009 and I came to homeopathy from research science, so I am comfortable with methodology, with evidence, and with saying plainly when something is not known.
